title: DogTag EU health certificate credential v1
description: recordType == EU_HEALTH_CERT. Mirrors the EU_HEALTH_CERT branch of packages/dogtag-standard-ts/src/schema.ts's validateSchema.

x-validationRules.description: validUntilEntry must equal validFrom + 10 days exactly. Cross-field date arithmetic; JSON Schema has no date-offset keyword.
onwardValid (when present as a string) must be <= validUntilEntry + 4 calendar months. Cross-field date arithmetic with calendar-month semantics (day clamping), not expressible via JSON Schema.
covers: EU_HEALTH_CERT: onwardValid must be <= entry + 4 months

echinococcusRequired.description: Optional. Only a literal boolean true activates the treatmentBeforeEntry range check below (schema.ts compares with === true, so any other value, including the truthy but non-boolean case, is inert rather than an error).

credentialSubject.description: microchip is REQUIRED for EU_HEALTH_CERT unconditionally - needsChip is always true for this record type, unlike DOG_PROFILE/SERVICE_ATTESTATION/CDC_IMPORT_FORM where it is optional.

treatmentBeforeEntry.description: Hours before entry the echinococcus treatment must have been administered.
